notes.title: Update #2
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45282216/c9a1f4df8f6fc0b34802110f2fc0c662a1df8bea.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45282216/84a00fda6b88218b204699bcac14c81898d9531f.png"][/img][/p][p]Thank you all for your feedback!!! This is a quality-of-life update, and here are the changes we've made:[/p][p]- New sounds have been added;[/p][p]- Added the ability to interact with the radio;[/p][p]- Moved the flashlight to a more visible location;[/p][p]- Added additional lighting for the fountain when interacting with it;[/p][p]- Added subtitles for Morpheus' monologue;[/p][p]- Added a warning disclaimer at the beginning of the game;[/p][p]- Fixed materials in the second location that were not loading;[/p][p]- Improved the cinematography of the second location by adding additional lighting, optimizing rain behavior and other weather aspects, and adding volumetric fog.[/p][p][/p][p]We would also like to thank the following people for their feedback: yannickgiard, Niwaka 69 :D, Kenta Kogai.[/p][p][/p][p]Every review is important to us, as we strive to create a positive gaming experience for every user![/p]
